name: Via Stitching
description: Stitch copper zones together with a grid of vias on a chosen net
description_full:
Fills the overlap of a net's copper zones (for example the top and bottom GND pours) with a grid of stitching vias, on whichever two copper layers you pick.

Works on KiCad 6 and later. There are two builds, and the Plugin and Content Manager installs whichever one your KiCad runs.

Features:
- Through, Micro, Blind, Buried, and Blind/Buried via types, on any layer pair.
- Hexagonal, square, or staggered patterns, with configurable diameter, drill, and spacing.
- X/Y offset for stitching more than one pattern onto the same area without overlap.
- Automatically avoids other nets' tracks, pads, zones, and existing holes, with proper clearances.
- Select an existing via to clone its settings, or let the dialog remember your last run.
- Placed vias are grouped together, and Reset last run deletes a whole run as a set.
- Dialog follows KiCad's own configured UI language: English, Dutch, German, or French.
